Félpálcás téglalap (03 §3.1 A)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
hdc – half double crochet
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
half double crochet (hdc)

Félpálcás téglalap
Row 1 – foundation: ch 17.
Row 2: skip 2 ch, hdc in each ch across (15 sts). Turn.
Rows 3–22: ch 2 (turning chain), 15 hdc (15 sts). Turn.
Row 23: ch 2 (turning chain), 15 hdc (15 sts). Fasten off.
